info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Removal API
info.description: The Customer Removal API allows businesses to delete customer records from their system, ensuring data management and compliance with privacy regulations. It operates on the specified customer ID to facilitate targeted data removal. Typical users include customer support teams and data management systems that require the ability to remove outdated or incorrect customer information. This API is essential for maintaining a clean and accurate customer database.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a customer record identified by the given customer ID. Ensure that the customer ID is correct, as this action cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: The request body for deleting a customer by ID. This payload should include the specific customer details necessary to process the deletion request.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content to return.
